votes.motion: Approve the work session minutes from July 11, 2023; July 18, 2023; September 5, 2023; and September 12, 2023, as well as the formal meeting minutes of September 5, 2023; September 12, 2023; and September 19, 2023.
votes.description: Routine approval of multiple prior work session and formal meeting minutes to create an official record.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 29 of 2023 declaring November 20th as Transgender Day of Remembrance in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall formally recognizing November 20th as Transgender Day of Remembrance in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items B-1 through B-3 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on three grant applications (Safe Streets for All, Victims of Crime Act, and Know Your Neighbor) and refers them to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 59 of 2023 amending the North Temple Boulevard Plan to keep Madsen Park at the current location and explore how to re-imagine it.
votes.description: Amends the North Temple Boulevard Plan to remove the recommendation to relocate Madsen Park and instead retain and reimagine it at its current location.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the rezone at 2157 South Lincoln Street to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone from RB to CSHBD2 at 2157 South Lincoln Street and defers a final decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the rezone and master plan amendment at 116 East Edith Avenue to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone from R-1/5,000 to CC and associated master plan amendment at 116 East Edith Avenue and defers a decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the rezone and master plan amendment at approximately 1720 South and 1734 South West Temple to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone from R-1/5,000 to R-MU-45 and associated master plan amendment at 1720 and 1734 South West Temple and defers a decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the alley vacation at approximately 1518 South 300 West to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed vacation of City-owned alleys adjacent to properties at 1518–1546 South 300 West and defers a decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Historic Preservation Overlay District Text Amendment to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed amendments to the H Historic Preservation Overlay District in Title 21A and defers a decision to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Resolution 30 of 2023 authorizing substantial amendments to the 2020-2024 Consolidated Plan, the 2023-2024 Annual Action Plan, and project allocations for dormant housing program income funds.
votes.description: Approves substantial amendments to the City's five-year Consolidated Plan and Annual Action Plan to recognize unallocated housing program income in compliance with HUD CDBG and HOME program regulations.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 60 of 2023, Alley Vacation at Approximately 2167 South 800 East.
votes.description: Vacates a portion of a City-owned alley adjacent to properties at 801–825 East Wilmington Avenue to allow for redevelopment within Council District 7.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 61 of 2023, Alley Vacation at Approximately 827 East Wilmington Avenue.
votes.description: Vacates a portion of a City-owned alley adjacent to properties at 825–829 East Wilmington Avenue and 820–830 East Elm Avenue, dividing it among abutting property owners.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 62 of 2023 Zoning Map Amendment at 1018 East 900 South.
votes.description: Rezones the property at 1018 East 900 South from RMF-35 to RMF-30 to allow the owner greater flexibility in housing types if the property is redeveloped.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 63 of 2023 rezoning properties at approximately 1435 South State Street and amending the future land use map with conditions requiring a development agreement, and adopt Ordinance 63B of 2023 amending City Code Subsection 21A.27.050.C.3 to permit building height up to 65 feet and five stories for the subject parcels.
votes.description: Rezones properties at 1433 and 1435 South State Street, 1420 South Edison Street, and 121 East Cleveland Avenue to FB-UN2 with conditions on dwelling unit replacement and active ground-floor uses, and amends the zoning code text to allow up to 65-foot building height on those parcels.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 64 of 2023 enacting temporary zoning regulations authorizing temporary increase in overnight capacity at the youth homeless resource center at 888 South 400 West for the full 180 days.
votes.description: Enacts temporary zoning regulations allowing the Volunteers of America Youth Resource Center to increase maximum capacity by up to fifty individuals for 180 days, expiring April 15, 2024.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 31 of 2023, authorizing an amendment to the interlocal agreement between the City and County for 2023 election services.
votes.description: Approves an amendment to the interlocal agreement with Salt Lake County to add services for the City Council District Seven special election using Ranked Choice Voting on November 21, 2023.

Approves all items on the consent agenda, including setting a public hearing date for the Subdivision Code Amendments and confirming eight board appointments to various City advisory committees and boards.
